impact:
Two nitpicks: (1) degradeCode/degradePlan set agreement: 'agree', which reads as "both providers agreed" unless the consumer checks the degraded marker first — a distinct label (e.g. 'degraded') or omitting agreement would be clearer. (2) combineCode drops chunks_reviewed from both sides, losing chunking telemetry whenever deliberation runs.

LIVE-CONFIRMED 2026-07-01 for (1): two real degraded reviews (one RATE_LIMITED, one PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE on the codex side) both returned deliberation.agreement='agree' with providers=[gemini] — a single-provider result labeled as agreement.
title: Deliberation polish: degraded results claim agreement 'agree'; chunks_reviewed dropped from combined result
